Home.metaDescription: House design, interiors, and construction in one studio. 5 marla, 10 marla, and 1 kanal plots in Islamabad, Rawalpindi, Gulberg Greens, DHA, and nearby cities. WhatsApp us.
Home.h1: Design it. Build it. In Islamabad and Rawalpindi.
Home.sub: Architecture, interiors, and construction in one contract — drawings that can be approved, and a site that matches them.
Home.workIntro: Houses. Each card names the society and the plot size.
Home.proofIntro: The render next to the pour. We label CGI as CGI. These pairs are from PGSHF, DHA III, and Gulberg Green — sites we actually built.
Home.cgiNote: CGI — a render, not a photograph
Home.process1Line: Plans, elevations, and 3D the family can argue about on WhatsApp.
Home.process2Line: Named licensed people stamp Form A-2. You bring the plot papers. The firm is not “CDA-approved.”
Home.process3Line: Grey structure, finishing, or turnkey. Weekly photos from site. CGI labelled as CGI.
Home.process4Line: A site that matches the drawings.
Home.chipIntro: Tell us what you need. WhatsApp opens with the plot and the service already in the message.
Home.close: A 10 marla plot in Gulberg Greens, a kitchen in Park View, a house in Mansehra, a showroom on the GT Road — start with the size and the society.
Home.reply: We reply on WhatsApp within one working day (PKT). Overseas clients: say your city and we will call at a time that works.
Home.freeLook: Free first look at the plot or drawings — not a discount.
Home.freeLookCta: Send the plot for a first look
